Name: 鹦鹉螺基地防御力量
Description: The Star League Defense Force (SLDF) was the largest military force in human history, with over 100 million soldiers serving in 486 divisions at its peak. The SLDF suffered horrific losses opposing Stefan Amaris in the Amaris Civil War.
ReputationStatements: Even ComStar occasionally requires the services of mercenaries, Commander. We will look highly upon you, should you aid us.

MissionSuccessStatements: Excellent work, Commander. I was right to put my faith in you. You're a critical part of the Restoration effort.
GoodFaithFailureStatements: It seems apparent that while you failed to achieve our goals, you engaged the enemy for as long as you were able. Better luck next time, Commander. May the Spirit of Blake be with you.
BadFaithFailureStatements: Far be it for a simple organization like Comstar to reprimand you in matters of warfare, Commander, but… Your performance on that operation was positively abysmal. We roundly condemn your inadequacies.
MissionSuccessStatement: 干得漂亮，指挥官。我把信任托付给你是对的。你是复国事业的关键一环。
GoodFaithFailureStatement: 这看起来似乎很显然，虽然你没有达成我们的目标，但已经尽你所能来和敌人交战了. 希望你下次能走运一些，指挥官. 希望布雷克的精神与你同在.
BadFaithFailureStatement: 像康星这样简单的组织本不该在战争事务上责备你，指挥官，但是……你在那次行动中的表现简直糟糕透顶。我们严厉谴责你的无能。
